name: pax8-mcp
description: Every Pax8 Partner API endpoint, plus an offline store that reconciles billing, tracks MRR, and catches usage overages no Pax8 tool surfaces.

pax8_client_id.title: PAX8_CLIENT_ID
pax8_client_id.description: Sets PAX8_CLIENT_ID for the Pax8 MCP server.

pax8_client_secret.title: PAX8_CLIENT_SECRET
pax8_client_secret.description: Sets PAX8_CLIENT_SECRET for the Pax8 MCP server.

pax8_oauth_scope.title: PAX8_OAUTH_SCOPE
pax8_oauth_scope.description: Sets PAX8_OAUTH_SCOPE for the Pax8 MCP server. Required by the generated client for credential refresh or hand-written auth flow.

pax8_audience.title: OAuth audience
pax8_audience.description: OAuth2 audience claim requested when minting the Pax8 token. The default is the partner API audience; change it only if Pax8 told you to.

pax8_base_url.title: Pax8 API base URL
pax8_base_url.description: Base URL for the Pax8 API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.

pax8_token_url.title: OAuth2 token URL
pax8_token_url.description: Token endpoint the client-credentials exchange posts to. Leave the prefilled default: the client ID and secret go only to Pax8's token manager or your API base URL's host, and a URL on any other host is refused before anything is sent.

pax8_no_config_write.title: Keep credentials off disk
pax8_no_config_write.description: Set to 1 to keep credentials off disk. The token cache becomes a no-op, so the connector mints a fresh token each run instead of writing one to config.toml. Leave blank for the default cached behaviour.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile (optional)
printing_press_client_profile.description: Only for tenant-gated multi-client deployments: binds the MCP server to an existing Printing Press client profile. Leave blank for a single-tenant install.

pax8_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP mode
pax8_mcp_read_only.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any state-changing call. Leave blank to keep every tool available.

pax8_no_local_data.title: Run without a local copy
pax8_no_local_data.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API and the response cache is off. Leave blank to keep the local store.

pax8_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
pax8_user_agent.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Pax8 requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

pax8_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
pax8_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.
